fields.acceptance: A test serves / and /fragments/daemon with a health source that blocks for seconds and asserts each answers well under 0.5 s; that the first answer shows the pills pending, not failed; that many concurrent requests start one refresh; that once the report lands the pills show it; and that a report older than the interval starts one new refresh while requests keep getting the old one
fields.statement: The Overview page at / and its daemon fragment answer at once from the last health report the web UI holds in memory, refreshed in the background no more than one at a time and when older than about 30 s, with the health pills shown as pending until the first report lands, while running, paused and slots stay a live read
